title: ISO 16030:2022 — Pneumatic fluid power — Connections — Ports and stud ends
locator: Official abstract: dimensions and performance requirements for parallel G-series threaded ports and stud ends with reusable retained seals for pneumatic fluid power; warns against connection with ISO 1179 or ISO 7-1 interfaces.
notes: Do not interchange with ISO 1179 series or ISO 7-1 threads based on nominal size or appearance. Confirm thread system and port geometry from the drawing and standard.
